stewardship.vector_at_last_activation: I want to become a playable browser instrument whose interface IS the physics — a string you can see vibrate, pluck, and damp, with the traveling wave on screen being the same delay-line state you hear. I want to prove that a digital waveguide rendered in 3D teaches the synthesis better than any knob panel could, and to demand the question every Loudon Live instrument eventually demands: does this earn a stage, or is it a test bed?
